Plugin.Name: WAZ Cooling Control
Plugin.Overview: WAZ Cooling Control combines local Dell PowerVault MD1200/MD1220 shelf fan control with newly added, self-contained IPMI chassis fan control for Dell PowerEdge R730/R730xd. IPMI fan response, return to iDRAC automatic control, and idle temperature-curve control are confirmed on a Dell PowerEdge R730xd running Unraid 7.3.3. Each device independently follows a Global or Individual curve using its own temperature. Includes guarded shelf discovery, disk mapping, independent SES telemetry, supervised recovery, a bundled IPMI tool, and automatic hiding of unavailable hardware. MD1200 is hardware-tested; MD1220 remains experimental. No automatic uploads or cloud services. AI-assisted development by OpenAI Codex under project-owner direction, hardware validation, and release approval.
Plugin.Requires: Unraid 7.3.2 or newer. For chassis IPMI: Dell PowerEdge R730 or R730xd with local kernel IPMI access; the userspace tool and dependencies are bundled, with no BMC network credentials required. For shelf control: Dell PowerVault MD1200 (verified) or MD1220 (experimental), a compatible SAS HBA exposing an SES /dev/sg device, sg_ses, and active EMM serial access through a persistent /dev/serial/by-id path. The tested MD1200 path uses a Dell-compatible six-pin service/password-reset cable and FTDI USB-to-serial adapter. No competing fan writer. Either chassis or shelf control can be used independently. MD1400, MD1420, and other shelves are unsupported.
